Details
  • Paper: Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation, CVPR 2015, 2014-11-14 (for fcn-r101-d8-ade20k)
  • Paper: Pyramid Scene Parsing Network, CVPR 2017, 2016-12-04 (for pspnet-r101-d8-ade20k)
  • Paper: Rethinking Atrous Convolution for Semantic Image Segmentation, arXiv, 2017-06-17 (for deeplabv3-r101-d8-ade20k)
  • Paper: Encoder-Decoder with Atrous Separable Convolution for Semantic Image Segmentation, ECCV 2018, 2018-02-07 (for deeplabv3plus-r101-d8-ade20k)
  • Paper: Deep High-Resolution Representation Learning for Visual Recognition, TPAMI 2020, 2019-08-20 (for hrnet-w48-fcn-ade20k)
  • Original code: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmsegmentation at c685fe6767c4
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/shelhamer/fcn.berkeleyvision.org (Caffe) (for fcn-r101-d8-ade20k): The ADE20K checkpoints are mmsegmentation's own training runs of re-implementations, not the authors' released code or weights.
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/hszhao/PSPNet (Caffe) (for pspnet-r101-d8-ade20k): The ADE20K checkpoints are mmsegmentation's own training runs of re-implementations, not the authors' released code or weights.
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/tensorflow/models/tree/master/research/deeplab (TensorFlow) (for deeplabv3-r101-d8-ade20k, deeplabv3plus-r101-d8-ade20k): The ADE20K checkpoints are mmsegmentation's own training runs of re-implementations, not the authors' released code or weights.
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/HRNet/HRNet-Semantic-Segmentation (PyTorch) (for hrnet-w48-fcn-ade20k): The ADE20K checkpoints are mmsegmentation's own training runs of re-implementations, not the authors' released code or weights.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmsegmentation/blob/c685fe6767c4cadf6b051983ca6208f1b9d1ccb8/README.md#license
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification), ADE20K (SceneParsing, 150 classes)
  • Kernel libraries: igev, cutlass_conv, cudnn_hacc, seg_conv, seg_up
  • Variants: fcn-r101-d8-ade20k, pspnet-r101-d8-ade20k, deeplabv3-r101-d8-ade20k, deeplabv3plus-r101-d8-ade20k, hrnet-w48-fcn-ade20k
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: ade20k-150
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): fcn-r101-d8-ade20k 3000x4000 (7.2 GiB peak allocated, 7.5 reserved); pspnet-r101-d8-ade20k 3000x4000 (7.2 GiB peak allocated, 7.5 reserved); deeplabv3-r101-d8-ade20k 3000x4000 (7.3 GiB peak allocated, 7.5 reserved); deeplabv3plus-r101-d8-ade20k 3000x4000 (7.2 GiB peak allocated, 7.5 reserved); hrnet-w48-fcn-ade20k 3000x4000 (7.2 GiB peak allocated, 7.5 reserved)
  • fcn-r101-d8-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 9 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 22 s (ONNX + engine).
  • pspnet-r101-d8-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 11 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 44 s (ONNX + engine).
  • deeplabv3-r101-d8-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 10 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 26 s (ONNX + engine).
  • deeplabv3plus-r101-d8-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 11 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 23 s (ONNX + engine).
  • hrnet-w48-fcn-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 36 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 30 s (ONNX + engine).
  • fcn-r101-d8-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • pspnet-r101-d8-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • deeplabv3-r101-d8-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • deeplabv3plus-r101-d8-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • hrnet-w48-fcn-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • fcn-r101-d8-ade20k load / first call: original 4.72 s / 0.393 s (512x512), portable 0.53 s / 0.073 s, kernels 0.91† s / 0.018† s
  • pspnet-r101-d8-ade20k load / first call: original 1.35 s / 0.092 s (512x512), portable 0.47 s / 0.082 s, kernels 0.77† s / 0.026† s
  • deeplabv3-r101-d8-ade20k load / first call: original 1.64 s / 0.031 s (512x512), portable 0.73 s / 0.081 s, kernels 0.91† s / 0.021† s
  • deeplabv3plus-r101-d8-ade20k load / first call: original 4.72 s / 0.662 s (512x512), portable 0.62 s / 0.095 s, kernels 0.75† s / 0.019† s
  • hrnet-w48-fcn-ade20k load / first call: original 1.48 s / 0.079 s (512x512), portable 0.62 s / 0.071 s, kernels 0.85† s / 0.014† s
  • † measured in the speed sweep after the portable load (or an earlier size) in the same process: file cache and kernels are warm, so the time is lower than a fresh start.
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5 (tools/speed_check.py), synthetic CUDA input (bench_inputs); peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
